slate_notes: Pregame snapshot, written ~4:55 PM ET. The evening slate hasn't started (first puck drop and tip at 7:00 ET; afternoon WPG@CHI and SEA@CAR not used). No college player props (ineligible in IN). 10 legs, all in different games except CGY@LA (Kempe over and Pospisil under are on opposite teams): 7 NHL SOG and 3 NBA. Carried 6 of the morning's 9 panel keeps. Dropped Kucherov O2.5 and RNH U2.5 because WinDaily's current pair at 2.5 is broken (both sides minus, about 27% hold, so no valid devig). Dropped Dobson U2.5 because WinDaily no longer lists a 2.5 SOG market for him, only 1.5. New legs: Pospisil U1.5 SOG, Trocheck U2.5 SOG, Herb Jones U1.5 3PM, Shannon U1.5 3PM. Every est_prob is a multiplicative two-way devig at the exact same half-point line, using the best price on each side from WinDaily. Those prices are still stamped Sat 9:05-9:25 AM ET (the page didn't refresh), and pairing the best price across books overstates the edge a bit. PrizePicks/Underdog app lines are UNCONFIRMED. Drop any leg whose app line differs or comes as a Goblin/Demon. 4:30 PM NBA report: Trey Murphy out (NO), Mitchell and Allen questionable (CLE), Edwards out (MIN), Duren out (DET), Giannis probable (MIA). Avg est_prob ~0.609.
